# 2 Baruch Chapter 26 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**26:1** And-I-answered and-said: Will-that-tribulation last-a-long [time], or-will-that-distress-grip [them] for-many-years?

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac Codex Ambrosianus. Chapter 26 is a single verse — Baruch's follow-up question asking about the duration of the tribulation. The answer unfolds across ch. 27 (the twelve woes) and ch. 28 (their aftermath).*
